title: 80s Style CRPG I grew up with - Phantasia: Beyond the Fourth Age
author: Epyx911
selftext:
The game is a working title. After completing my first person Roguelike project, I wanted a party based CRPG like the games i grew up with in the 80s...Ultima, Phantasie, Wizard's Crown, Wizardry. Phantasie in particular wowed me at the time because it was a D&D party moving overland as a group with dungeons, towns and a massive world map to explore on my Commodore 64.

OF course it's primitive by todays standards but for 13 year old me in 1985 Phantasie blew me away.  This is a tribute to that game and still not far from done but now fully playable from start to finish (plot/story). My focus now is to polish and bring QOL up to 2026 standards.

Workflow used:

I developed my own set of rules (old rules I had for a tabletop RPG dedicated to Phantasie). I modernized them and developed a full design document for Fable to use.  
  
ART:   
  
Overland Tiles: David Baumgart the artist for Dungeons of Dredmor. I purchased his tiles which I honestly find are perfect for the aesthetic I wanted.

Monsters: Until I find a proper set of high resolution monsters (not pixel art or low res) im using these ChatGPT created set in the color and aesthetic style of the overland tiles.

UI: Unity Asset store RPG GUI

Music: Suno...I can't believe how far Suno has come..it may not be to everyone's taste but it was dialed in with what I wanted prompt wise.

Sound Effects: Various free sources. Still need to add SFX to combat as its currently using blips and bloops lol.

Code: Fable+ Opus 4.8

Combat system mechanics/levelling and rules: My design

The game features TTRPG style tactical combat with a level cap of 30...A full spellbook and multiple skill trees separated by class and general. 

Dungeons are a combination of manually created and procedural generated. THe map was handcrafted to accompany my storyline in TILED and then exported to Fable along with my design document.

While it is fully playable currently I want to polish it and hopefully replace the placeholder art with some that vibes more fully with the Tileset.    
  
Hope to have it finished by end of August.
